details.problem: The existing machine learning workflow for analyzing geospatial imagery was slow and manually intensive. The deployment platform, Docker Swarm, also lacked the automation and resilience needed for a secure, air-gapped environment.
details.solution: I developed a high-accuracy deep learning model for image segmentation and automated the entire data pipeline using Python and Apache Spark. I then led the infrastructure migration from Docker Swarm to a self-sustaining Kubernetes cluster on Amazon EKS, which I deployed and managed using Helm charts and YAML configurations.

impact.text: Improvement in model training efficiency (reduced training time from 8 hours to 4.8 hours per epoch)
Reduction in manual operational overhead (automated 12 hours/week of manual deployment tasks)
Test accuracy achieved on segmentation models (improved from baseline 87% to 95% on validation set)
